features.quote: Set a hard limit on turns (e.g., 20 turns max).
features.justification_quote: If the context window fills up, the model might degrade in quality simply due to truncation, not 'distress.'

features.quote: The loop should terminate if: The model explicitly quits (e.g., outputting "I give up"). The model repeats the exact same action 3 times (loop detection). The turn count reaches 20.
